name: io.github.jacobpmiller/whatsdownnow
title: WhatsDownNow
description: Live outage status, AI fallbacks, and alerts for 250 apps, AI APIs, and cloud services. No auth.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Current status of one service: verdict (up/degraded/down/unknown), plain-English summary, official status page level, our own HTTP probe, and user reports in the last hour. For AI API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and others on /ai), also returns recommended_fallbacks — currently healthy alternatives you can switch to.

slug.description: Service slug or common name, e.g. chatgpt (or 'openai'), claude (or 'anthropic'), aws, stripe. Use list_services to discover slugs.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services WhatsDownNow monitors (slug, name, category). Optional filters: query (a name like 'openai' or 'google cloud'; returns the best matches) and category (AI, Developer & Cloud, Work & Productivity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Social & Streaming, Money & Shopping, Gaming, Home & Security, Banks & Investing, Internet & Phone, Travel & Delivery). You rarely need this before create_alert_stack, which accepts common names directly.

query.description: Service name to look up, e.g. 'OpenAI', 'Cloudflare', 'Chase'

category.description: Only list services in this category

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Readiness check for a set of dependencies (e.g. an AI app's stack: chatgpt, claude, aws, vercel, supabase, stripe). Returns overall verdict (worst of the set), ready=true only if all are up, and per-service status. Use before running jobs that depend on these services.

slugs.description: Services to check: slugs or common names, e.g. ['openai', 'stripe', 'vercel']

tools.name: create_alert_stack
tools.description: START HERE to set up outage alerts for a user. One call, no account or API key. Creates an alert stack that notifies an email address (double opt-in: the recipient clicks one confirmation link) and/or a webhook URL (signed JSON; Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost and Rocket.Chat incoming-webhook URLs are auto-formatted when the host is recognizable) when any listed service goes down, stays degraded for N minutes, or gets N user reports in an hour, plus a recovery notice. Services accept slugs or common names ('openai', 'ChatGPT', 'Anthropic', 'AWS', 'Google Cloud'). If the user didn't say where alerts should go, ask for an email or a Slack, Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat webhook URL first. Returns the stack id, a management token and a private manage_link, all shown ONCE: give the user the manage_link and tell them to keep it private.

services.description: Services to watch: slugs or common names, e.g. ['openai', 'stripe', 'cloudflare']

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST alerts to. Slack, Microsoft Teams (webhook.office.com / Power Automate), Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost (*.mattermost.com) and Rocket.Chat (*.rocket.chat) incoming webhooks are auto-formatted; other URLs get signed JSON. Self-hosted Mattermost or Rocket.Chat at a generic host can pass format explicitly via the API.

email.description: Email address for alerts (recipient must click a confirmation link)

on_down.description: Alert as soon as a service is Down (major outage)

degraded_minutes.description: Alert when degraded or down for at least this many minutes; null = off

reports_per_hour.description: Alert when user reports in the last hour reach this; null = off

components.description: Optional official component names to filter official/probe alerts (e.g. ['API']). Empty means all components. User-report alerts still fire even when a component filter is set.

notify_recovery.description: Also send a notice when the service recovers

share_enabled.description: If true, publish a read-only live status page at a public /s/pub_… URL (does not expose the private stack id). Default off.

share_index.description: If true, allow search engines to index the public status page. Requires share_enabled. Default off (noindex). Ignored when a share password is set.

share_password.description: Optional password for the public status page. The page stays unlisted. Password-protected pages cannot be embedded.

digest_enabled.description: If true, send a weekly email digest of the last 7 days of outages to confirmed addresses on this stack.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: PagerDuty Events API v2 integration/routing key. Stored on the stack and never returned.

opsgenie_api_key.description: Opsgenie API key. Stored on the stack and never returned.

monitor_url.description: Optional https URL of a custom website to check on the existing alerts cadence (SSRF-protected, capped at 3 per stack).

tools.name: get_alert_stack
tools.description: Read a stack you created: its services and their current status, alert rules, delivery channels (including whether an email is confirmed), firing alerts and recent deliveries. Needs the stack id and its management token.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

tools.name: update_alert_stack
tools.description: Add or remove services, add an email or webhook destination, publish or hide a read-only public status page, or rename a stack you created. New emails get a confirmation link. Needs the stack id and its management token.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

add_services.description: Slugs or names to start watching (default rules)

remove_services.description: Slugs or names to stop watching

add_webhook_url.description: Another https webhook (Slack/Teams/Google Chat/Discord/Mattermost/Rocket.Chat/JSON) to notify

add_email.description: Another email address to notify (must confirm)

share_enabled.description: Publish (true) or unpublish (false) a read-only live status page. The public URL uses a separate pub_ id, not the private stack id.

share_index.description: Allow search engines to index the public status page. The page stays noindex unless this is true. Ignored when a share password is set.

share_password.description: Set a password on the public status page, or null to clear it. Password-protected pages stay unlisted and cannot be embedded.

digest_enabled.description: Turn the weekly email digest on or off for this stack.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: Add a PagerDuty Events API v2 routing key. The key is never returned.

opsgenie_api_key.description: Add an Opsgenie API key. The key is never returned.

opsgenie_region.description: Opsgenie API region for opsgenie_api_key. Default us.

monitor_url.description: Add a custom https website monitor (max 3 per stack).

remove_monitor_id.description: Remove a custom monitor by id (mon_…).

mute_slug.description: Catalog service to mute (snooze) on this stack so a known incident does not start a new alert.

mute_hours.description: 1–168 hours to mute mute_slug, or 0 to clear the mute. Required when mute_slug is set.

tools.name: send_test_alert
tools.description: Send a test alert to every active channel of a stack right now (confirmed emails, webhooks, browser push) so the user can see what alerts look like. Needs the stack id and its management token.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

tools.name: rotate_alert_stack_key
tools.description: Replace a stack's management token and manage_link. The old token and link stop working immediately. Use this if the manage_link may have leaked. Returns the new token and manage_link once; give the new manage_link to the user privately. Counts toward the stack's daily change limit. Needs the stack id and its current management token. The stack itself is not deleted.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

tools.name: delete_alert_stack
tools.description: Permanently delete a stack and stop all its alerts. Only do this when the user asks. Needs the stack id and its management token.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Recent incidents for a service: official incidents from its status page (when available) plus verdict changes WhatsDownNow detected.

slug.description: Service slug or common name, e.g. chatgpt (or 'openai'), claude (or 'anthropic'), aws, stripe. Use list_services to discover slugs.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Ask WhatsDownNow to start monitoring a service that is not in the catalog yet. Humans can also do this at /request. Votes for the same name are counted together. Optional url helps us find the site; optional reason is noted. Optional email is only used to notify the requester when the service is added (double opt-in; never marketing). If the name already matches a tracked service, the live slug is returned instead of a new request.

reason.description: Why this service should be added (optional)

email.description: Optional address to notify when it's added (we send a confirmation link; never marketing)

tools.name: get_ai_fallback
tools.description: For AI API providers WhatsDownNow already tracks (OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic/Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Perplexity, Cohere, xAI, DeepSeek, Together, Replicate, Hugging Face, OpenRouter, Fireworks), return currently healthy alternatives you can fail over to. Pass provider (slug or common name, e.g. 'openai' or 'chatgpt') for alternatives to one provider; omit it for the whole AI health board. Latency figures are from our HTTP probe of the public endpoint or status page, not model inference latency.

provider.description: AI provider slug or name, e.g. chatgpt, openai, claude, anthropic. Omit to list every AI API we track.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Tell WhatsDownNow that your agent or app hit an error talking to a tracked service. Use this when you see 5xx, timeouts, or rate limits, even if our status page still says up — reports from 6+ independent networks within 30 minutes are flagged as an 'Unverified agent-report spike' (it never changes the official/probe verdict). Fields: service (slug or name), error_type (5xx, timeout, rate_limit, auth, network, other), optional model and region. Rate-limited and deduplicated per network. Also counts toward user-report alert thresholds.

service.description: Service slug or common name, e.g. chatgpt, anthropic, aws

model.description: Model id if known, e.g. gpt-4.1 or claude-sonnet-4

region.description: Region or endpoint if known, e.g. us-east-1

detail.description: Optional short note (no secrets or personal data)
